raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Second of the smaller PRs splitting #56285 per review ("encrypted_content ... could be handled separately"). @chaunceyjiang

With `include=["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` the non-Harmony Responses API attaches an opaque reasoning blob to reasoning items — streamed (`response.output_item.done` for reasoning) and non-streamed alike — instead of discarding the reasoning text, and replays the blob back into the prompt on the next turn, enabling `store=false` clients (Codex-style) to continue sessions without resending reasoning. The blob is encoded, not encrypted: vLLM holds no key, it only has to survive a client round trip (zlib + urlsafe base64 with a `vllm-reasoning-v1.` prefix). Replayed items prefer explicit `content` over the blob; foreign blobs fall back to `summary` with a warning; main's previous behavior of raising `VLLMValidationError` on any `encrypted_content` input is replaced by this decode path.

**Coordination note.** Per the review comment on #56285, `encrypted_content` may also serve the proposed `/responses/compact` endpoint — #56970 (draft) adds that endpoint and is the natural place to unify the two, so the encoding format here (`_REASONING_STATE_PREFIX`) is intentionally self-describing and cheap to adopt there.

## Tests

```
pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_responses_utils.py \
       tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_streaming_events.py \
       tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_serving_responses.py -q
# 100 passed, 1 xfailed
```

New: encrypted reasoning only when requested; content preferred over the blob; blob restores reasoning for store=false replay; foreign blob falls back to summary; streamed reasoning done item carries the decodable blob. Unchanged from main: everything else (the previous `test_encrypted_content_raises` expectation is replaced by the decode behavior above).

 logger = init_logger(__name__)
 
+_REASONING_STATE_PREFIX = "vllm-reasoning-v1."
+
+
+def encode_reasoning_state(text: str) -> str:
+    """Opaque ``reasoning.encrypted_content`` blob for ``store=false`` replay.
+
+    Encoded rather than encrypted: vLLM holds no key, the blob only has to
+    survive a client round trip intact.
+    """
+    packed = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(zlib.compress(text.encode("utf-8")))
+    return _REASONING_STATE_PREFIX + packed.decode("ascii")
+
+
+def decode_reasoning_state(blob: str | None) -> str | None:
+    if not blob or not blob.startswith(_REASONING_STATE_PREFIX):
+        return None
+    try:
+        raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(blob[len(_REASONING_STATE_PREFIX) :])
+        return zlib.decompress(raw).decode("utf-8")
+    except (ValueError, zlib.error, UnicodeDecodeError):
+        return None
+
